messages:
maya: Quick kickoff — we need a compact nurture for the week-of-launch mini burst. Objective: webinar signups + trial starts. Timeline: Launch email Wed 9am PT, follow-up Thu 11am PT, reminder Mon 8am PT. Who owns segments/copy? 

sam: I can take segmenting. Proposed segments: 1) Active trial users, 2) MQLs last 90d, 3) Cold-engaged (opens in 30d). Want to add a small VIP list for partners. 

oliver: I’ll draft 3 subject variants and 2 preview texts by EOD tomorrow. Tone: benchmark-led — highlight latency/cost wins + webinar CTA. 

lee: For routing: send trial users to dedicated flow (A) with product CTAs; MQLs to flow (B) with webinar-first CTA; cold-engaged to flow (C) focused on webinar invite + social proof. 

maya: Nice. Sam — can you publish segment rules here? short snippet is fine. ops-bot: segment build complete: seg_437_active_trial, seg_812_mql_90d, seg_099_cold_open_30d. 

sam: Segment rules (draft):
```
seg_437_active_trial: last_activity <= 14d AND trial_status = active
seg_812_mql_90d: lead_score >= 50 AND last_touch <= 90d
seg_099_cold_open_30d: last_open <= 30d AND last_click = null
```

nora: Heads up — webinar registration page needs a UTM param change to match ad creative. I'll update: utm_campaign=sparkplug_launch_v1. Also add hidden field for partner_source. 

maya: Copy owners: Oliver subject/body, Nora landing page + UTMs, Sam list rules + suppression. I’ll own scheduling and QA. 

oliver: Draft subjects: 1) "See inference at 10ms — join the walkthrough" 2) "How we cut token cost by 40% — live demo" 3) "Behind the scenes: predictable LLM inference". Short preview lines ready. 

sam: One ask — add suppression rule to exclude customers on dedicated contracts: `customer_tier = enterprise` so we avoid overlap. 

lee: Can ops-bot run a quick seed send to 50 internal users for Wednesday? Need inbox rendering check + tracking pixels. 

ops-bot: scheduled seed send to #marketing-inbox at 2024-11-06T16:00:00Z. Delivery report will post in thread. 

maya: Perfect. Last bit — A/B plan: variant A emphasizes benchmark numbers, variant B emphasizes customer story + quote. Oliver please mark which subject pairs map to A/B. 

oliver: Will do. Uploading copy v1 to drive and will tag here when ready. Expect link by 1716170000. 

maya: Thanks everyone — I’ll follow up with the final send checklist tomorrow. :thumbsup:
